tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page ground behind every admin screen. A faint green-grey, like engineering graph paper.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, tables, inputs and dialogs that sit on `paper`.

tokens.name: sunken
tokens.usage: Side navigation, table headers, hovered rows and empty uptime days.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows and around panels. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: rule-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, selects and secondary buttons. Holds 3:1 on `surface` and `paper` in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and the primary button fill. Reads on `paper`, `surface` and `sunken`.

tokens.name: ink-soft
tokens.usage: Secondary text such as navigation items and table cells that are not the row's name.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Hints, URLs under monitor names, axis labels and mono labels. At least 4.5:1 on `paper`, `surface` and `sunken`.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The one brand hue: links, quiet buttons, selected navigation marker, the focus ring and region series 1. Never a status.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of links and quiet buttons.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an `accent` fill.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element, offset 2px. At least 3:1 on `paper` and `surface` in both themes.

tokens.name: up
tokens.usage: Monitor is up: the circle glyph, its label and full uptime days. Text-safe on `surface` and `up-tint`.

tokens.name: up-soft
tokens.usage: Uptime days above the orange threshold but below green. A mark only, never text.

tokens.name: up-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of an up status chip.

tokens.name: degraded
tokens.usage: Monitor is degraded (some regions failing, or slow): the triangle glyph, its label and orange uptime days.

tokens.name: degraded-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a degraded status chip.

tokens.name: down
tokens.usage: Monitor is down: the square glyph, its label, red uptime days and destructive buttons.

tokens.name: down-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of a down status chip and of the down count in navigation.

tokens.name: on-down
tokens.usage: Text on a `down` fill (the destructive button).

tokens.name: unknown
tokens.usage: No data yet: the ring glyph and its strip day. A mark only; the label next to it uses `muted`.

tokens.name: overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind dialogs and the command palette.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Ground of the current side navigation item and of the chosen option in an open menu. `ink`, `muted` and `accent` all read on it in both themes.

tokens.name: focus-halo
tokens.usage: Soft 3px halo outside the solid `accent` edge of a focused input or open select. Decoration only; the solid edge carries the 3:1 contrast.

tokens.name: down-halo
tokens.usage: Halo of a focused input that has an error.

tokens.name: control-highlight
tokens.usage: 1px inner top highlight on filled buttons (primary, danger) and checked checkboxes. Gives the fill a pressable edge.

tokens.name: series-1
tokens.usage: Latency chart: first selected region (us-east by default).

tokens.name: series-2
tokens.usage: Latency chart: second region.

tokens.name: series-3
tokens.usage: Latency chart: third region.

tokens.name: series-4
tokens.usage: Latency chart: fourth region.

tokens.name: series-5
tokens.usage: Latency chart: fifth region.

tokens.name: series-6
tokens.usage: Latency chart: sixth region.

tokens.name: series-7
tokens.usage: Latency chart: seventh region.

tokens.name: series-8
tokens.usage: Latency chart: eighth region.

tokens.name: series-9
tokens.usage: Latency chart: ninth region.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Page title: the monitor name on its detail page, or the section name on index pages. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Panel titles on detail pages and dialog titles.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Form section headings and monitor names in rows.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Select at least one region before saving.
styles.usage: Default admin text, inputs and table cells.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.sample: Checks run every minute from each selected region.
styles.usage: Field hints, helper copy, button text in small buttons.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Headline numbers: uptime percentage, p50 latency, open incidents. Always with its unit.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: URLs, latency cells, timestamps, HTTP codes. Tabular figures.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Labels, region codes, column headers with normal letter spacing.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between uptime days; glyph to label.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between chips.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding (vertical) and gap between fields in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding and row padding (horizontal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between panels and between form sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page gutter on desktop; space under the page title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Space before a new page region, such as the danger zone.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Uptime days, status squares, keyboard hints and badge swatches.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, navigation items, checkboxes and options inside an open menu.

tokens.name: radius-control
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select triggers and segmented controls.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Panels, dialogs, region grid and the command palette.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status chips only.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs, open menus and the command palette.

tokens.name: shadow-control
tokens.usage: Things you press: buttons, select triggers and the checked segment. Removed while pressed. The only shadow allowed on resting content.

tokens.name: shadow-inset
tokens.usage: Things you type into: text inputs and input groups. Reads as a slot, the opposite of a button.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons and selects inside rows, panel headers and segmented controls.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and select triggers.

tokens.name: control-touch
tokens.usage: Height of every control and menu option on coarse pointers (phones, tablets).

tokens.name: option
tokens.usage: Height of an option row inside an open menu on fine pointers.
